how_chosen: Cases a to c use certified-business rows already stored with the site fixtures. Cases f and f2 add four more published rows from the same certified-business list (extra-sbs-rows.json). Case e adds one published IRS row (extra-irs-rows.json). Each case is a real published organization, not an invented example.
